dedupe_keys.name: rcp8 5 ecearth racmo larsim me climate flow projections for the german waterways rhine elbe and danube

description: This dataset from the German Federal Institute of Hydrology (BfG) contains projected daily river flows for the German waterways Rhine, Elbe and Upper Danube under the RCP8.5 pathway, made to study how internal climate variability and bias correction affect the climate change signal of flow indicators relevant to navigation. The 16-member ensemble of the regional climate model KNMI-RACMO2 driven by EC-EARTH (1951 to 2100) was bias corrected against HYRAS observations with no correction, linear scaling or quantile mapping, downscaled to 5 km and used to drive the LARSIM-ME hydrological model. Observed mean daily flows for eight gauges (Kaub, Köln, Ruhrort, Pfelling, Hofkirchen, Dresden, Magdeburg and Neu-Darchau) for 1951 to 2017 from the Federal Waterways and Shipping Administration are included. It was produced by Bastian Klein and Dennis Meissner in the EU IMPREX project (version 1.0, March 2020). Coverage is regional. The data are free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and available to download as five NetCDF files. Caveats: one emission pathway and one model chain are used, and the non-commercial licence limits reuse. It supports climate adaptation planning for low-water navigation and port access on the Rhine and Elbe. It complements the BfG seasonal and monthly streamflow forecasts and is related to the Port of Switzerland Rhine port statistics.
name: RCP8.5-ECEARTH-RACMO-LARSIM_ME climate flow projections for the German waterways Rhine, Elbe and Danube
